releaseNotes: Fixed black edges and gaps during pan, push and slide transitions - clips now tile the frame exactly
64 motion presets, 34 formula patterns, 32 transitions, 41 effects and 26 easing curves
Card thumbnails are now distinct per option instead of repeating one photo
Easing picker shows an animated curve graph so you can see the motion before applying it
Export verifies the finished MP4 really contains a video track (and an audio track when you added music) before saving
Saved videos go to Movies/AutoEdit and extracted frames to Pictures/AutoEdit - both appear in Gallery immediately
Projects now save text overlays, audio tracks, effect layers and quality settings - nothing is lost on reopen
Fixed back easings overshooting twice as far as intended
In-app update: correct version compare (1.10.0 > 1.9.0), verified downloads, clear errors instead of silent failure
